text: The Commercial Vehicle (CV) domestic business in India recorded sustained volume expansion driven by infrastructure capex and replacement cycles. CV EBITDA margin improved to 10.9% on disciplined realization and product mix optimization.

section: Management Discussion & Analysis - Jaguar Land Rover (JLR)
text: Jaguar Land Rover achieved record revenues of GBP 29.0 billion in FY24. Free cash flow generation reached GBP 2.3 billion, enabling net debt reduction from GBP 3.0 billion down to GBP 700 million, targeting a net cash positive status by FY25.

Key operational risks include supply chain bottlenecks for next-generation electric vehicle semiconductors, commodity price volatility across aluminum and lithium cell chemistries, and tariff shifts in key European automotive export corridors.

The Board approved a composite scheme of arrangement for the demerger of Tata Motors into two standalone listed entities: Commercial Vehicles and Passenger Vehicles (PV, EV, and JLR) to optimize capital allocation and strategic focus.
